accepted_sources.title: Comparison of Multi-Level Image Thresholding Performances of Meta-Heuristic Search Algorithms
accepted_sources.read_depth: Journal landing page, Turkish and English abstracts, references read; linked PDF not read.
accepted_sources.finding: Compares 11 meta-heuristics for 2–8-level thresholding on 100 images with Friedman analysis; moth-flame and particle-swarm methods ranked best in this experiment, not a general DTF guarantee.

accepted_sources.title: Stripe Chromakey Using Active Contour Models
accepted_sources.read_depth: J-STAGE page, metadata, abstract and references read; linked 9-page PDF not read.
accepted_sources.finding: Uses a two-tone striped background to disambiguate foreground colors matching the background, then refines regions with active contours; controlled-capture technique, not arbitrary-artwork removal.

accepted_sources.title: DTF Color Management Guide: ICC Profiles, RIP & Calibration
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full visible guide read, including ICC setup, white-ink management, linearization, ink limits, soft-proofing, gamut limits and post-press shifts.
accepted_sources.finding: Emphasizes printer/ink/film-specific output profiles, measured charts, documented RIP settings and profiles validated against pressed transfers; commercial guidance not independently certified.

accepted_sources.title: 关于图像抖动实验 (Image Dithering Experiment)
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full visible article read through Bayer, Floyd–Steinberg, dynamic Bayer, palette quantization, octree and implementation sections.
accepted_sources.finding: Contrasts ordered Bayer dithering with error diffusion; ordered patterns can be visible, while Floyd–Steinberg distributes quantization error. Serpentine scanning can reduce directional artifacts; code is educational, not production-ready.

accepted_sources.title: O emprego da análise de imagem na determinação da distribuição de tamanho de partículas da areia presente no esgoto sanitário
accepted_sources.read_depth: SciELO HTML article read across methods, binary processing, results, discussion and references.
accepted_sources.finding: Describes grayscale conversion, threshold binarization, morphological hole filling and separation of touching clusters; manual decisions were reported in a 2,700-image workflow, highlighting the cost of QA.

accepted_sources.title: Segmentación de Imágenes en Color utilizando Histogramas Bi-Variables en Espacios Color Polares Luminancia/Saturación/Matiz
accepted_sources.read_depth: Paperity preview read, including Spanish/English abstracts and substantial introduction/method text; linked PDF and publisher page could not be fetched.
accepted_sources.finding: Uses hue/saturation and luminance/saturation histograms, watershed-based morphological clustering, back-projection and saturation-based combination of chromatic/achromatic partitions.

accepted_sources.title: popcon-matting-bench: Matting Model Benchmark for LINE Animated Emoji Background Removal
accepted_sources.read_depth: GitHub repository page and full visible README read, including models, halo/coverage metrics, commands, sample results and limitations.
accepted_sources.finding: Pairs perimeter-normalized halo score with foreground coverage; shows low halo alone can hide lost thin details. Small high-contrast cartoon sample cannot rank models generally.

accepted_sources.title: RVMとMatAnyone2のVideo Matting halo は「撮影由来」か「コード由来」か切り分けた
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full visible 216-line GitHub article read, including code paths, test conditions, edge-band measurements and despill proposal.
accepted_sources.finding: Separates physical green spill from a fixed green fill introduced by inference post-processing using natural-background and contrasting-composite tests; author-defined metrics are local.

accepted_sources.title: Binary Morphology on Run-Length Encoded Image
accepted_sources.read_depth: Official OpenCV page read, including representation, operations, boundary semantics and performance guidance.
accepted_sources.finding: Run-length encoding can speed morphology on structured binary masks with large/custom kernels, but may be worse for noisy masks and small rectangular/cross kernels; benchmark-driven dispatch.

accepted_sources.title: How AI Background Removal Works
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full visible 113-line guide read, including alpha, difficult cases, edge cleanup, shadow handling, local/cloud processing and checklist.
accepted_sources.finding: Separates segmentation, soft alpha, decontamination and edge decisions; recommends contrasting composites, preserving originals, inspecting narrow gaps at 100%, and disclosing local/cloud processing before upload.
